narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Instrument Faceplate"**

The site is a precise instrument in the 1960s Ulm-school sense: one matte faceplate set on a slightly darker desk, cut into modules by engraved seams, with raised keys you press and recessed wells you read. Numbers are measurements, not decoration. Every interactive thing is a physical-feeling key; every piece of status is a readout behind glass. One orange key colour is reserved for the action or signal that matters now.

Density is calm and generous. Modules breathe (large block padding), rows inside them are separated by engraved seams rather than cards, and the eye moves left-to-right from a label column to a body column across a vertical cut. The site is still by default: nothing moves until the visitor presses, hovers, or follows a cross-reference, and under reduced motion even that is removed.

Light is the lead theme. Dark is the same instrument in anodised graphite, with the same tokens re-valued, never a different world. The previous dark cyan/violet world (glass cards, scroll-reveal cascades, magnetic tilt, conic borders, custom cursor) is retired and must not return.
keyCharacteristics: One faceplate (the plate) on a desk margin; the whole page sits inside it.
Raised keys for real links and buttons; recessed wells for readouts.
Engraved seams: a dark 1px line with a 1px highlight beneath it.
Archivo variable grotesk, using its width axis: wide and heavy for display, condensed caps for engraved labels.
Tabular, lining figures wherever a number is a measurement.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange means "this is the thing, now": the résumé key, the live status LED, the lit cross-reference, the caret. It is never used for headings, hover states, selection, confirmations, active list items, decoration, links in prose, or a second call to action. The build holds this rule everywhere.

rules.name: The Same Instrument Rule
rules.body: Dark mode re-values the same tokens; it adds no colour, no glow, and no new surface. A component that needs a dark-only colour is wrong.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Any number that is a measurement uses tabular lining figures. A metric is a value at full readout weight, an optional unit at half size in ink-3, then a plain-language label beneath; units never sit at readout weight.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Engraved labels name a panel, a field, or a group. They never sit above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: A key at rest is raised; pressing, opening, or toggling it sinks it (Key Down shadow, translateY 1px). Depth changes only in response to the visitor.

dos: Do make every raised key a real `<a>` or `<button>`, and put read-only values in recessed wells.
Do reserve signal-orange for the résumé key, the lit status LED, the lit `:target` cross-reference marker, and the caret.
Do separate rows and modules with engraved seams (dark line plus highlight) rather than card borders.
Do set measurements with tabular lining figures, with any unit at half size in ink-3 after the value.
Do link every metric key to its proof.
Do show photos at 3:4 inside a well window, with the backdrop matched to the panel grey in light and graphite in dark.
Do keep the desk margin visible around the plate at every width.

Do keep motion interaction-only (key press 120ms, switch 200ms, underline and theme crossfade 220ms, all on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and remove it under prefers-reduced-motion or the stored reduce-motion preference.
Do follow the system theme by default and honour the stored manual choice before first paint.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading; engraved labels name panels, fields, and groups only.
Don't use orange for headings, hover states, selection, confirmations, active items, prose links, decoration, or a second call to action.
Don't style a non-interactive element as a raised key.
Don't set tech tags or the navigation as pills.
Don't add scroll-triggered reveals, ambient animation, parallax, or a custom cursor.
Don't bring back the retired dark cyan/violet world: no glass cards, glows, conic borders, or magnetic tilt.
Don't add a monospace face or set display text in a system face; Archivo carries every role.

motion.focal: Power-on sequence on first home visit per session (html.boot set in <head>): seam-y 800ms, seam-x 900ms+200ms, shutter clip-path 760ms+120ms, glint 1000ms+820ms, LED flicker 700ms+260ms, readout warm 600ms (+380/520ms), keys rise 420ms staggered 560-740ms. Class removed at 2.6s.
supporting: Odometer metric wheels: digits become 20-digit bands, WAAPI translateY to 10+digit em, ~0.9-1.4s, staggered, first time the strip is 35% visible.
Nav selector knob: one 2px ink bar, translateX + scaleX to the active link, 420ms.
Projects tuning needle: sticky dial under the nav; needle position interpolated from row positions vs 45% viewport line; lamp orange only when within 0.18 of a station.
Portrait glint on hover (900ms), key press 120ms, theme switch 200ms, theme crossfade 220ms.
motion.reducedMotion: No boot class, no odometer wheels (final values static), knob and needle move without transition; global rule zeroes durations.
